title: Performance Portrait Canvas: Per-model & Per-route Token/Latency Chart Suite
creator: Aisha R. Coleman
description: Proposal and specs for a compact ‘Performance Portrait’ canvas that surfaces per-model and per-route metrics in a single glance. The canvas emphasizes token flow, latency percentiles, throughput lanes, and cost attribution to help SREs/product engineers quickly diagnose regressions and tuning opportunities. This ticket covers layout, interaction patterns, and low-level chart primitives (waterfall, ridgeline percentiles, batch occupancy strips, cache hit sparklines, and cost breakdown).
acceptance_criteria: Designs include a responsive canvas for both model-level (single model across routes) and route-level (single route across model variants) views
Chart primitives defined with axis behavior, aggregation window defaults, and suggested percentiles (p50,p95,p99) for latency
Prototype (Figma) shows hover drill into token waterfall and ability to switch aggregation (1m/5m/1h)
Hand-off spec includes color tokens, accessible contrast ratios, and mobile/tablet layout rules
Product/Eng sign-off recorded with a prioritized implementation plan and a single spike for runtime metric availability
decisions: Show latency percentiles as ridgeline/stacked bands rather than overlapping line-series to reduce visual clutter for long-tailed distributions
Expose batch occupancy as a horizontal heat strip mapped to batch-size buckets (1..32) to make batching tuning actionable
Cost attribution displayed as per-1k-tokens breakdown with model variant stacking; exclude non-billable control plane tokens by default
Default aggregation window set to 5m for dashboard load, with 1m and 1h quick toggles
chart_specs: Token Waterfall (horizontal stacked bars): shows prefix, decode, KV-cache lookup, kernel compute, network encode. X-axis = ms per token; tooltip shows sample traces and associated request id
Percentile Ridgeline (vertical stack of density bands): rows = variants/routes, bands = p50/p75/p95/p99, overlay median as dashed line
Continuous Batch Occupancy Strip: 1px-high time-series heatmap where x=time, y=batch-size bucket; color = requests/sec in that bucket; hover shows batch-size distribution for the hovered window
KV Cache Hit Sparkline: compact sparkline with moving-average annotation and a delta badge versus baseline window
Throughput Lane Bars: per-route throughput stacked by model-variant with error-inset (5xx/4xx) small glyphs
Cost-per-1k Tokens Donut + Drill: donut shows % cost by variant; clicking opens a cost-time-series with token volume overlays
interaction_patterns: Hover on waterfall: expands into microtrace panel with sample token timings and link to tracing UI
Click on variant row: pins that variant to top and applies cross-filter across all charts
Time-range scrub: brushing updates all charts and triggers a lightweight re-aggregation (server-side) for the selected window
Export: CSV of selected time window and selected metrics; PNG export for the whole canvas
Anomaly highlight: when backend marks a bucket anomalous, show amber strip with reason and link to incident

tradeoffs_and_risks: Single-canvas approach increases initial cognitive load vs multiple specialized tabs. Chosen solution favors situational awareness (quick triage) but may require a subsequent 'deep-dive' tab. Metric cardinality (many variants x many routes) could overload the UI; mitigation: top-n selector + adaptive summarization server-side.
